description: Erection of a single storey front extension, a first floor side extension, conversion of loft space involving alterations to existing roofline, two dormer extensions at rear and rooflight to front roofslope, alterations to roof of existing single storey side and rear extension including installation of roof lantern and alterations to fenestrations.
decision_conditions: The proposed mono-pitched roof at ground floor, due to its excessive width and lack of any set back would create an awkward junction with the front bay feature and would fail to relate sympathetically to the original features of the house, appearing unduly dominant on the principal elevation and resulting in an incongruous and contrived appearance of the built form on this elevation that would cause significant and unacceptable harm to the character and appearance of the original house and the ASLC's street scene, contrary to Policies 28 and 30 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018 and the guidance contained within Supplementary Planning Document 4 'Design of Residential Extensions (SPD 4), SPD 14 'Creating Locally Distinctive Places', as well as 'The Burton Estates' ASLC - Character Appraisal.

The proposal, due to the lack of any set back at first floor, together with the increased ridge height and lack of setdown at roof level, would fail to appear subordinate and would result in a symmetrical built form in an attempt to appear as an originally built house. The proposal would result in significant and unacceptable harm to the character and appearance of the existing dwelling and the Burton Estates' streetscene, characterised with well-established asymmetrical front appearances of the houses. As such, the proposal is contrary to Policies 28 and 30 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018 and the guidance contained in the Council's Supplementary Planning Document 4 'Design of Residential Extensions' (SPD4), as well as 'The Burton Estates ASLC - Character Appraisal' document.
